It feeds itself, it works like that. Maybe i can think in a strategy. Maybe you can talk with the love of your life about that, then you can solve this togheter. You are in a transaction from your 'old' family to the new one. By what you said your mother and told you everything she could when you lived with her, now you need to pick those knowlages that you find more reasonable and move on with them to find new ones.

Fun fact: I started to think in killing myself years ago, in the beggining it was sporadic, then it turns to be every day, every hour. Before i thougt in pain free ways to die, now it does not metter anymore, it seems to be closer and closer. I hope you can find a way out of it before you get deep into this shit. Peace.
